text: Binary per-row flag from the `argument` column only (the OP's own text; title not used): 1 if the OP, in their own voice, explicitly asks readers for emotional support (comfort, reassurance, encouragement) or for assistance/help (e.g. coping with or resolving a personal situation); otherwise 0. Returns 0 when there is no explicit request, including when the OP only asks to have their view challenged or changed in the standard CMV way, or only describes feelings without asking for support or help. Excludes quoted text from others, moderator/bot notices, OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (even if thanking people or mentioning support); generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be considered. Uses the supplied current text including marked edits, with no initial snapshot reconstructed. Returns null if the argument is missing or malformed.
